## Attendance

J. Whitfield chaired the meeting. Attendance was recorded as: J. Whitfield, S. Rahman, Priya Anand, R. Adeyemi, L. Petrov.

The board noted the attendance record and confirmed that the meeting considered performance information for May 2021.

## Performance

The board reviewed 1597 captures for May 2021. The reported backlog was 132, while the number of letters was 3. These figures were noted for the board record.

The board considered the position reported through the available performance information and agreed that the matters requiring further attention should remain visible to the programme.

## Items

The lead grader reports that graders stopped looking at model output after repeated false alarms on ungradable images.

The board noted the implications of this report for the use and review of model output. The issue was recorded for continued consideration, with the circumstances described by the lead grader retained in the meeting record.

## Actions

Actions carried forward to the next meeting. The board will retain the reported performance position and the lead grader’s report for further consideration. The backlog of 132, the total of 3 letters, and the 1597 captures will remain part of the programme record for May 2021.
